title: T23 agent-core: themes — profile field, routes, signed library, contrast check (0.7.27)
head: t23-themes
body:
**needs Braden** — signed library path (T23)

## What

- New `theme` field in `profile.yaml` (optional string, decision #77/#78): `ProfileStore.load_theme()`/`save_theme()` mirror `load_avatar()`/`save_avatar()` exactly — a missing profile, missing key, or unknown/uninstalled id all fall back silently to the bundled default `lantern`; `save_theme()` is the strict half (raises `MemoryStoreError` on an invalid or unavailable id, requires an existing profile). `theme` is popped before the agent-facing `Profile` is built, so it never enters model input (decision #73). `Drawer`/`ProfileStore` both gain a `theme_available` predicate constructor keyword alongside `avatar_available`.
- New `src/anorak/theme_pack.py`: a pure validator for `theme.yaml` — structure per `docs/formats.md`'s "Theme pack" section (§1) then, only once both variants' shape is good, a WCAG 2.1 contrast check (§2: 4.5:1 text pairs, 3:1 UI pairs, the `lamp`-vs-`bg` rule). Kept in step with playbooks' `validate.py`/`contrast.py` by the contract, not a shared import (agent-core cannot depend on playbooks without a cycle, contract §3).
- New `src/anorak/themes.py`: bundled theme metadata only (`lantern`) — the same split T17's `avatars.py` uses for Beacon; a bundled pack's actual token values are desktop-app's own static `tokens.ts`, never re-served here.
- New `src/anorak/theme_library.py`: the signed library cache (`~/.oasis/themes/<id>/`), mirroring `avatar_library.py`'s fetch/verify/cache/install-job machinery, narrowed to one file per pack (`theme.yaml`, no sprite sheet). Reuses `avatar_library.AssetFetcher`'s redirect-following transport directly (generic, not avatar-specific; both publish to `RDW-Labz/oasis-assets`) behind a small exception-translating wrapper. `ACCEPTED_SIGNING_KEYS` starts empty (decision #78/#159, its own namespace, independent of avatar's): every refresh/install answers `not_set_up`/`503` and nothing is fetched until Braden's key exists (#78) — no release exists yet.
- New routes on `LocalService` (mirror the avatar ones): `GET /themes`, `POST /themes/refresh`, `GET /themes/:id/tokens` (parsed, already-validated token JSON only — no raw `theme.yaml` route, decision #159 settled point 6), `GET`/`PUT /theme`, and the four `/themes/:id/install-job`/`install` routes (same `Job` shape/states/`select`/cancel semantics as avatars). `PUT /theme` and every profile write run through `_theme_known`, which requires the id to actually pass §1/§2 validation (installed-and-passing library, listed-and-passing drawer, or bundled) — never just an id-shape check. A stored id that becomes unavailable falls back to `lantern` at load and logs one `theme_cache_refused` line; a drawer theme failing AA is refused at load (logged, falls back), no warn-only path. `theme.changed` WS event + `theme_set` audit line on a successful switch.
- `service_cli.py` wires a second `ThemeLibrary`/`AssetFetcher`/`httpx.AsyncClient` alongside the avatar ones, with its own shutdown ordering.
- Version 0.7.26 → 0.7.27 everywhere it's asserted (`pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock`, `ServiceRuntime.version`, `anorak.__version__`, `chat_service.py`'s two `skill_version` literals, `local_service_adapters.py`'s `Skill.version`, and the matching test expectations). `CHANGELOG.md` updated.

## Checks

<!-- swarm:checks -->

## Mutation check

| mutant | killing test |
| --- | --- |
| `theme_pack.validate_theme_bytes`: drop `"dark"` from the required top-level keys (accepts a `theme.yaml` with only `light`) | `test_theme_pack.py::test_missing_dark_is_refused` |
| `LocalService._theme_known`: always return `True` (PUT /theme saves without running §1/§2 validation) | `test_theme_library.py::test_put_theme_refuses_id_that_fails_validation_not_just_shape` (+ `test_themes.py::test_invalid_put_does_not_write`, `test_get_unknown_stored_id_falls_back`) |
| `ProfileStore.load_theme`: return the stored value without checking `_theme_available` (an unknown/uninstalled id is kept instead of falling back to `lantern`) | `test_themes.py::test_profile_load_ignores_invalid_theme`, `test_get_unknown_stored_id_falls_back`; `test_theme_library.py::test_uninstalled_stored_id_falls_back_and_service_logs_once` |
| `theme_pack._contrast_errors`: stub to always return `[]` (a low-contrast theme passes) | `test_theme_pack.py::test_low_contrast_theme_fails` (+ `test_theme_library.py::test_invalid_pack_bytes_refused`) |
| `ThemeLibrary.available`: always return `True` (skips the load-check/drawer validation a PUT relies on) | `test_theme_library.py::test_put_theme_refuses_id_that_fails_validation_not_just_shape`, `test_tampered_on_disk_cache_is_unavailable_and_logged_once` |
| `ThemeLibrary._drawer_pack`: skip the `validate_theme_bytes` call (a drawer theme failing AA is accepted) | `test_theme_library.py::test_drawer_theme_failing_contrast_is_unavailable_and_falls_back`, `test_put_theme_refuses_id_that_fails_validation_not_just_shape` |

Each mutant was applied by editing, `pytest` run to confirm the failure, then restored by re-applying the original code (no `git checkout`/`stash`); `git diff` against the pre-mutation commit is clean. 6/6 killed.

uv run ruff check . → All checks passed!
uv run ruff format --check <touched files> → already formatted (pre-existing drift in a few untouched lines elsewhere in local_service.py/service_cli.py/chat_service.py/local_service_adapters.py, not part of this diff)
uv run mypy --strict src → Success: no issues found in 56 source files

## Open for Braden

- Signing keys: `ACCEPTED_SIGNING_KEYS` is empty in both `avatar_library.py` and `theme_library.py` (#78) — the theme library path here is built and tested with throwaway Ed25519 test keys only, same as avatars until a release exists (#78).
- Round-one theme palettes (the 8 sets matching T22's avatar sets) are explicitly out of this PR (contract §7 point 5 / §8 point 5) — a separate job proposes them and shows you a preview before anything ships; only the bundled `lantern` id exists here.
- Contract §7 point 1's wording tension (an unknown stored `theme` id: silent fallback vs. hard profile-load failure) is resolved here the way the contract's own provisional read settles it — silent fallback, matching `avatar`. Flag if you want the stricter reading instead.
